summary: FileRise is an open-source web-based file manager that lets you handle file transfers, uploads, and organisation directly through a browser interface. It includes features such as tagging, shareable links, multiple layout views including gallery and table formats, and an integrated text editor.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams needing a straightforward, self-hosted web interface to manage files and share links without relying on commercial cloud storage.
watchOut: The project operates with steady but modest maintenance health and faces significant competition from much larger, more established alternatives in the self-hosted file management space.
deployNotes: Since it is distributed via Docker and built with PHP, you will typically need to configure persistent volume mounts for your stored files and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
